nodes.description: KittyInterface public ck: external CryptoKitties contract reference used for all kitty transfers and gene reads
Destiny destiny: external battle/entropy contract used to decide the winner
Game[] public games: array holding all games, players, fightBlock and winner; length mutated and indexed by gameId
address constant public TIE = address(-2): sentinel value marking a tied game
enter(uint256 kitty) external: pulls kitty via ck.transferFrom, seats caller as player1 or player2, starts fightBlock and emits events
resolve(uint256 gameId) external: publicly callable, computes winner via getWinner and pays out both kitties with ck.transfer
getWinner(uint256 gameId) public view: validates game, derives blockhash seed, calls destiny.fight and maps result to a player or TIE
catGenes(uint256 kitty) private view: reads kitty genes from ck.getKitty
maxRandom(uint256 sourceBlock) public view: returns uint256(block.blockhash(sourceBlock)) after requiring block.number > sourceBlock
bitSlice(uint256 n, uint256 bits, uint256 slot) public pure: masks and shifts bits out of n
random(uint256 upper) public view: pseudo random using block.number - 1 as source block
random(uint256 upper, uint256 sourceBlock) public: returns maxRandom(sourceBlock) % upper
Destiny.fight(bytes32 cat1, bytes32 cat2, bytes32 entropy) public returns (bytes32 winner): external battle oracle called by getWinner
KittyInterface.getKitty(uint256 _id) external view: external gene lookup returning the full kitty struct
KittyInterface.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 kittyId): external NFT transfer used to escrow kitties into the arena
KittyInterface.transfer(address to, uint256 kittyId): external NFT transfer used to pay out the kitties
constructor(KittyInterface _ck, Destiny _destiny): stores the external contract references
KittyInterface.approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) public: unused approval entry point of the external interface
msg.sender: untrusted caller address used as escrow owner and stored as player address
ck.transferFrom(msg.sender, this, kitty) external call executed before every arena state update in enter()
ck.transfer(game.winner == TIE ? player1.addr : game.winner, player1.kitty) and the symmetric player2 transfer in resolve()
destiny.fight(genes1, genes2, seed) external oracle call inside getWinner() whose return value decides payouts
games.length += 1 and games[games.length - 1] under Solidity 0.4.24 unchecked arithmetic in enter()
kitty: enter() parameter, the kitty id being escrowed
gameId: resolve()/getWinner() parameter used to index the games array
cat1: Destiny.fight parameter, first kitty genes
cat2: Destiny.fight parameter, second kitty genes
entropy: Destiny.fight parameter, the blockhash derived seed
upper: random() modulus bound
sourceBlock: maxRandom() parameter naming the block whose hash is used
n: bitSlice() parameter, value to slice
bits: bitSlice() parameter, slice width
slot: bitSlice() parameter, slice index
_ck: constructor parameter assigned to state variable ck
_destiny: constructor parameter assigned to state variable destiny
player: Player storage pointer set to game.player1 or game.player2 in enter()
game: Game storage pointer aliasing games[gameId] / games[games.length - 1]
genes1: genes of player1 kitty obtained from catGenes()
genes2: genes of player2 kitty obtained from catGenes()
seed: bytes32(maxRandom(game.fightBlock)) blockhash derived entropy used for the fight
winnerGenes: bytes32 returned by destiny.fight() and compared against genes1/genes2
genes: catGenes() return value built from ck.getKitty()
offset: slot * bits computed in bitSlice()
mask: ((2**bits) - 1) << offset computed in bitSlice()
_genes: destructured field from ck.getKitty() in catGenes()

edges.reason: constructor parameter _ck is written into state variable ck
constructor parameter _destiny is written into state variable destiny
constructor performs the ck assignment
constructor performs the destiny assignment
msg.sender is passed as the from address of ck.transferFrom
the kitty argument is passed as tokenId to ck.transferFrom
enter() executes the external ck.transferFrom call first
enter() increments games.length without overflow protection under 0.4.24
the games array length is the operand of the unchecked increment
the incremented length is written back into the games array storage
kitty is stored in the Player struct assigned to player
msg.sender is stored as the player address of the seating Player
the player struct assignment is persisted into the games array
games storage element is aliased by the game local pointer
caller supplied gameId indexes the games array without bounds or ownership validation
resolve() calls getWinner(gameId) to compute the payout target
gameId is forwarded from resolve() to getWinner()
catGenes() of player1 kitty yields genes1
catGenes() of player2 kitty yields genes2
catGenes() calls ck.getKitty() to read kitty data
_genes destructured from ck.getKitty() is cast into genes
sourceBlock is used by maxRandom() to select the hashed block
seed is derived from block.blockhash via maxRandom(), a miner-influenceable block dependency
genes1 is the first argument of destiny.fight()
genes2 is the second argument of destiny.fight()
seed is passed as the entropy argument of destiny.fight()
winnerGenes returned from the oracle flows into the winner selection logic
the address returned by getWinner() is stored as game.winner in resolve()
the TIE sentinel is returned by getWinner() when entropy is unavailable or the oracle is inconclusive
game.player1.kitty and game.player2.kitty are the tokenIds transferred out in resolve()
resolve() transfers both escrowed kitties to the resolved winner or their owners on a tie
resolve() is externally callable by anyone with no access control and it triggers the prize payouts
the external kitty transfer in resolve() can call back into the arena before game.winner state is final
the external ck.transferFrom call executes before the game/player storage is updated in enter()
destiny.fight() is an external call made before computeFinalWinner state is committed, allowing reentrancy into getWinner()/resolve()
upper bound is used as the modulus in random()
n is ANDed with the computed mask in bitSlice()
bits determines the mask width in bitSlice()
slot determines the shift offset in bitSlice()
offset derived from slot*bits is used to build mask
cat1 is the first gene argument of the Destiny.fight call
cat2 is the second gene argument of the Destiny.fight call
entropy is the third argument of the Destiny.fight call

normalization_plan.reason: kitty is a transient parameter that only feeds the ck.transferFrom unsafe operation
gameId is only meaningful as the index used by resolve() to select a game
cat1 is only consumed by the Destiny.fight external oracle call
cat2 is only consumed by the Destiny.fight external oracle call
entropy is only consumed by the Destiny.fight external oracle call
upper is a trivial bound parameter of random()
sourceBlock is only used by maxRandom() to pick the hashed block
n is a pure input of bitSlice()
bits is a pure input of bitSlice()
slot is a pure input of bitSlice()
_ck is only used by the constructor to set the ck state variable
_destiny is only used by the constructor to set the destiny state variable
the player storage pointer is a temporary alias created inside enter()
the game storage pointer is a temporary alias used by resolve()/getWinner()
genes1 is a temporary value produced for getWinner() comparison
genes2 is a temporary value produced for getWinner() comparison
seed is only produced to be passed as entropy to destiny.fight()
winnerGenes is the direct return value of the destiny.fight unsafe operation
genes is the return value assembled inside catGenes()
offset is an intermediate value local to bitSlice()
mask is an intermediate value local to bitSlice()
_genes is a destructured temporary inside catGenes()
